"# 🏦 FinScore AI — Alternate Credit Scoring for Rural India

> **AI-powered credit assessment for 190M+ unbanked Indians who lack traditional credit history**

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![SDG 1](https://img.shields.io/badge/SDG%201-No%20Poverty-E5243B)](https://sdgs.un.org/goals/goal1)
[![SDG 10](https://img.shields.io/badge/SDG%2010-Reduced%20Inequalities-DD1367)](https://sdgs.un.org/goals/goal10)

---

## 📋 Problem Statement

Traditional credit scoring systems like CIBIL exclude **190 million+ rural Indians** (World Bank, 2022) who:
- Work in informal sectors (farming, daily wage labor, street vending)
- Have no bank statements, salary slips, or formal employment records
- Are forced to borrow from predatory moneylenders at **24-48% annual interest** (RBI Report, 2023)
- Include women-led Self Help Groups and tribal communities facing severe financial exclusion

**Most affected states:** Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha

## 💡 Our Solution

FinScore AI uses **alternate financial behavior data** to generate fair credit scores:

| Traditional (CIBIL) | FinScore AI (Alternate) |
|---------------------|------------------------|
| Bank statements | UPI transaction frequency & amount |
| Salary slips | Monthly informal income |
| Credit card history | Utility bill payment consistency |
| Loan repayment records | Mobile recharge patterns |
| N/A | Agricultural yield (seasonal) |

### Key Features
- **XGBoost ML Model** trained on alternate financial indicators
- **Google Gemini AI** explains scores in simple Hindi/English
- **RAG Pipeline** provides personalized RBI-backed financial tips
- **Bias-tested** across gender, region, and income groups
- **Privacy-first** — no Aadhaar, PAN, or biometric data stored

---

"RBI Financial Inclusion Guidelines and Schemes for Rural India
=============================================================

SECTION 1: PRADHAN MANTRI JAN DHAN YOJANA (PMJDY)

The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a national mission for financial inclusion launched on August 28, 2014. Under PMJDY, every adult Indian citizen is entitled to open a zero-balance savings account at any bank branch or Business Correspondent (BC) outlet. The account comes with a free RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh, and an overdraft facility of up to Rs 10,000 for eligible account holders. As of 2023, over 50 crore PMJDY accounts have been opened across India, with approximately 67% of accounts in rural and semi-urban areas. The scheme has been instrumental in bringing the unbanked population into the formal financial system. PMJDY account holders also benefit from direct benefit transfers (DBT) of government subsidies and schemes, eliminating middlemen and reducing leakages.

For farmers who maintain regular savings in their PMJDY accounts, financial institutions view this as a positive indicator of financial discipline. Even small, consistent deposits of Rs 500-1000 per month demonstrate responsible financial behavior. Banks may consider PMJDY account activity as supplementary evidence when evaluating loan applications from rural borrowers who lack traditional credit histories.

PMJDY account holders who have maintained their accounts in good standing for at least six months are eligible for the overdraft facility. This micro-credit feature allows them to borrow small amounts without any collateral, building a track record of borrowing and repayment that strengthens their creditworthiness over time.

SECTION 2: MUDRA YOJANA (PRADHAN MANTRI MUDRA YOJANA)

The Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) provides loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises. MUDRA loans are available in three categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh), and

"# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FinScore AI — Spring Boot Backend Dockerfile
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Multi-stage build:
# Stage 1: Maven build (compile + package JAR)
# Stage 2: JRE 17 runtime (minimal image for deployment)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ─── Stage 1: Build ─────────────────────────────────────────
FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17 AS build

WORKDIR /app

# Copy POM first for dependency caching
COPY pom.xml .
RUN mvn dependency:go-offline -B

# Copy source code and build
COPY src ./src
RUN mvn clean package -DskipTests -B

# ─── Stage 2: Runtime ───────────────────────────────────────
FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

WORKDIR /app

# Copy built JAR from build stage
COPY --from=build /app/target/*.jar app.jar

# Expose port (configurable via PORT env var)
EXPOSE 8080

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:${PORT:-8080}/api/states || exit 1

# Run the application
# All configuration via environment variables
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]
"
args.Description: "Multi-stage Docker build for Spring Boot: Maven build stage + JRE 17 runtime. Includes health check."

args.CodeContent:
"# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FinScore AI — Python ML Service Dockerfile
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Builds the FastAPI ML service with XGBoost model training
# and RAG pipeline initialization baked into the image.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

FROM python:3.10-slim

WORKDIR /app

# Install system dependencies for FAISS and sentence-transformers
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Copy requirements first for dependency caching
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Train the ML model during build (generates credit_model.pkl)
RUN python model/train_model.py

# Expose port
EXPOSE 8000

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:${ML_PORT:-8000}/health || exit 1

# Run FastAPI with uvicorn
CMD ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
"

---

## Step 1 — Push Code to GitHub

Your project needs to be on GitHub first.

```powershell
cd "E:\AI HAcKaTHON\credit-scoring"

# Initialize git (if not already done)
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit - FinScore AI"

# Create a repo on GitHub, then push:
git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/finscore-ai.git
git branch -M main
git push -u origin main
```

> Your `.gitignore` already excludes `.env` files and `*.pkl` model files.
> **Never push your `.env` file** — it contains API keys and passwords.

---

1. Go to [aiven.io](https://aiven.io) → Create free account

3. Copy the **Service URI** — it looks like:
   ```
   mysql://avnadmin:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/defaultdb?ssl-mode=REQUIRED
   ```

### Option B: PlanetScale (free tier)
1. Go to [planetscale.com](https://planetscale.com)
2. Create a database → Get connection string

### Option C: Render PostgreSQL (free 90 days)
> [!NOTE]
> If using PostgreSQL, change `DB_DRIVER` to `org.postgresql.Driver`
